stories.title: 2 policemen martyred, 1 injured in attack en route to polio duty in KP's Mohmand
stories.brief: The governor noted that polio workers “perform a national duty to protect children and promote a healthy Pakistan” and said the government was responsible for providing security to polio teams. In September, two policemen were martyred as armed assailants fired at a polio vaccination team in Balochistan’s Noshki.

stories.title: Two policemen martyred, one injured in attack on polio team in K-P's Mohmand
stories.brief: Two policemen were martyred, and another was injured when unidentified armed men attacked a polio vaccination team in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's (K-P) Mohmand district on Tuesday, District Police Officer (DPO) Raza Muhammad Khan said.

stories.title: Petitions against detention of Sohail Afridi, others referred to PHC CJ for constitution of larger bench
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: A Peshawar High Court (PHC) bench on Tuesday referred multiple petitions challenging the detention of PTI leaders, including Sohail Afridi — the non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister — to the chief justice for the constitution of a larger bench.

stories.title: PHC sends petitions challenging detentions of Afridi, others to CJ to form larger bench
stories.brief: The petition was filed amid uncertainty over Afridi’s whereabouts following the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in K-P on October 11, which brought the PTI-led provincial government to an end and transferred its powers to Governor Faisal Karim Kundi.

stories.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
stories.brief: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

stories.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
stories.brief: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.

stories.title: From scooters to shampoo - the people saving hundreds from dumpster diving
stories.brief: The men and women who rummage through commercial bins to take clothes and other items.

stories.title: Dar reaffirms govt's commitment to public relief in meeting with JI delegation
stories.brief: On September 3, the government and JI agreed to establish technical committees to examine proposals for reducing the petroleum levy and fuel prices. On September 12, JI chief announced a long march towards Islamabad for September 20, warning that the party would intensify its campaign if the government did not abolish the levy.

stories.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after collision
stories.brief: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel died on Tuesday as a result of injuries he suffered in a sickening collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper in a Spanish second division match. Andorra also sent their "most sincere condolences" to De Miguel's family, team-mates and Tenerife.

stories.title: Pakistan offers to share energy crisis management experience with Bangladesh
stories.brief: Titumir shared the steps taken by Bangladesh to ensure fuel security and address emerging challenges, saying the current crisis had brought energy security to the forefront of policymaking. Both sides stressed the importance of continued engagement and sharing experiences to address common energy challenges and build greater resilience against future global supply disruptions.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi agree to enhance cooperation in media, culture, tourism
stories.brief: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Saudi Ambassador to Pakistan Dr Rajeh Tami Albugamy on Tuesday agreed to further strengthen cooperation between the two brotherly countries in the fields of information, broadcasting, media, culture, and public relations.

stories.title: ECP issues show-cause notice to MQM-P over intra-party elections
stories.brief: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) issued a show-cause notice to Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) for failing to fulfil the legal requirements for holding intra-party elections within the extended deadline of October 15, 2026, emerged on Tuesday.

stories.title: Drivers may get compensation offers before car finance saga ends
stories.brief: The regulator says it supports lenders offering early compensation offers, as long as they are fair.

stories.title: Charity warns about damage of over-foraging fungi
stories.brief: It says over-foraging, particularly in protected areas, damages habitats and wildlife.

stories.title: Apple unsure when it will get more foldable iPhones ahead of Christmas
stories.brief: The tech giant reports strong sales but admits "constraints" are affecting supplies of the iPhone Duo.

stories.title: Welsh public sector unlikely to meet net zero plans by 2030, say auditors
stories.brief: A watchdog has criticised the lack of progress made by organisations in tackling climate change.

stories.title: Major study into 'forever chemicals' in people's bodies launched in UK
stories.brief: The government is launching the first study to measure PFAS in the UK population to understand the risks.

stories.title: Asian Cup postponed in wake of attacks on Saudi Arabia
stories.brief: The 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia is postponed because of a series of deadly attacks on the host country.
